name: Respondent
description_en:
Respondent is a product in the Surveys and feedback category. Its directory profile covers Skip Logic, Support Audio / Images / Video, Phone Survey, Online Survey, Multiple Question Types, Mobile Survey, Email Distribution, Data Analysis Tools.

Additional listed capabilities include Custom Survey URLs, 360 Degree Feedback. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: set supported survey addresses for sharing. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
